channel.title: Brazil Elections 2026
channel.description: Real-time monitoring of the 2026 Brazilian presidential elections.

item.title: Aliados de Lula pedem que TSE barre estreia de Dark Horse antes da eleição
item.description: Lula's allies, including federal deputy Rogério Correia (PT-MG) and the group Prerrogativas, urged the TSE to block the premiere of the film 'Dark Horse,' which portrays the political trajectory of Jair Bolsonaro, until the October elections. They argue the release could influence the electoral process. The request aims to prevent the film from being used as a campaign tool before the vote.

item.title: Crusoé: O “mais importante” da AtlasIntel, segundo Sóstenes
item.description: The leader of the PL in the Chamber of Deputies, Sóstenes Cavalcante (RJ), commented on the AtlasIntel/Bloomberg poll showing a six-point drop in Flávio Bolsonaro’s second-round performance against Lula. He emphasized that the most important point is that Lula did not gain ground, despite Bolsonaro’s decline.

item.title: Veja o trailer de Dark Horse, filme de Jair Bolsonaro
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro shared the trailer for the biopic 'Dark Horse', financed with R$ 61 million by Daniel Vorcaro, owner of Banco Master. The film, starring Jim Caviezel as Jair Bolsonaro, depicts the 2018 stabbing attack and an alleged conspiracy against the former president, featuring English dialogue and the translated campaign slogan. The release followed leaked audio of Flávio and Vorcaro discussing a US$ 24 million payment for the production.

item.title: Lula pede estudo sobre baixa adesão ao programa Reforma Casa Brasil
item.description: President Lula requested a study from Caixa Econômica Federal to identify why the Reforma Casa Brasil program has low uptake, suggesting bureaucracy as a likely barrier despite widespread public interest in home improvements.

item.title: Lula diz que redução de jornada levará em conta cada categoria
item.description: President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva advocated for a sector-specific approach to reducing work hours in Brazil, emphasizing that no single rule should apply to all workers and that realities of each profession and economic sector must be respected. He linked the discussion to automation and technological advancement, arguing that the 6×1 work scale is necessary to give workers more time for family and personal life. Lula also launched the Move Aplicativos credit program, offering up to R$30 billion in funding for app-based and taxi drivers, during his São Paulo agenda focused on construction and urban mobility.

item.title: Polícia apura contrato entre SP e ONG de produtora de “Dark Horse”
item.description: São Paulo's Civil Police opened an inquiry into alleged irregularities in a R$108.8 million contract between the city hall and the NGO Instituto Conhecer Brasil, linked to journalist Karina Ferreira da Gama, producer of the film 'Dark Horse'. Suspicions include lack of competitive bidding, the NGO's lack of expertise to install free Wi-Fi networks, payment of R$26 million without services rendered, and possible fund transfers to related companies. The investigation also examines ties to parliamentary amendments for deputy Mário Frias and the film's financing by Bolsonaro allies.

item.title: PL descarta “plano B” para eleição presidencial após reunião com Flávio
item.description: Federal deputies from the PL party stated, following a meeting with Senator Flávio Bolsonaro (PL-RJ), that the party has no 'plan B' for the 2026 presidential election and remains united behind the pre-candidate. They reported that Flávio was in good spirits during the meeting and reaffirmed their support for his candidacy.

item.title: Flávio admite visita a Vorcaro após a primeira prisão do banqueiro
item.description: Senator Flávio Bolsonaro (PL-RJ) confirmed he met with former Master Bank CEO Daniel Vorcaro after the banker's first arrest to collect unpaid installments for the financing of a biopic about his father, Jair Bolsonaro. He stated the contacts were solely for this purpose and promised to present financial accountability within 30 days, while also advocating for a Congressional Inquiry (CPI) into Banco Master.

item.title: Galípolo volta a relatar reunião com Vorcaro no Planalto em 2024 e diz que Lula orientou 'tratamento técnico'
item.description: Central Bank President Gabriel Galípolo reiterated in Senate CAE testimony that President Lula instructed him to handle banker Daniel Vorcaro's complaint in a 'technical' manner, after Vorcaro alleged financial system persecution. Galípolo said he was summoned by the Presidency's office to attend the December 2024 meeting already underway, and that Lula affirmed his technical autonomy. The episode is being referenced amid controversy over Flávio Bolsonaro's alleged negotiations with Vorcaro for film investments, which opposition groups are using to pressure the Bolsonaro candidacy.

item.title: Galípolo diz que Lula orientou tratar caso Master ‘de forma técnica’
item.description: Central Bank President Gabriel Galípolo stated in a Senate hearing that President Lula instructed him to handle the Banco Master case technically, emphasizing his autonomy and the absence of political bias. He said he was summoned by the presidential office for a December 2024 meeting with Lula and banker Daniel Vorcaro, during which Vorcaro claimed persecution by major banks—a claim Galípolo deemed largely unfounded relative to Master’s market size. In February, Lula confirmed the meeting, stating there would be no political stance for or against the bank, only a technical investigation, mediated by former Finance Minister Guido Mantega.

item.title: Flávio Bolsonaro divulga primeiro trailer de ‘Dark Horse’
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro released the first trailer of 'Dark Horse', a cinebiography of his father Jair Bolsonaro, during a press briefing on Tuesday afternoon, March 19. The approximately two-and-a-half-minute video is styled as leaked content, featuring early scenes in English and a reenactment of the stabbing Jair Bolsonaro suffered in September 2018.

item.title: Flávio e Eduardo Bolsonaro divulgam trailer de 'Dark Horse' em meio a desgaste por elo com Vorcaro
item.description: Flávio and Eduardo Bolsonaro released the trailer for 'Dark Horse', a film about their father Jair Bolsonaro's life, amid political backlash linked to the Vorcaro case. The brothers shared the video on social media on Tuesday (19) as a strategy to reinforce their family image and political narrative. The move comes amid increasing scrutiny over the Bolsonaros due to investigations tied to the Vorcaro case.

item.title: Flávio Bolsonaro divulga trailer de ‘Dark Horse’; assista
item.description: Senator Flávio Bolsonaro released the trailer for 'Dark Horse', a biographical film about Jair Bolsonaro depicting scenes such as his marriage to Michelle, the 2018 stabbing attack, and messages of resistance against the system. The film, with a budget of 134 million reais, has faced delayed payments, prompting Flávio to request financial support from banker Daniel Vorcaro, as revealed in an audio leak obtained by the Federal Police and reported by The Intercept Brasil.

item.title: A reação do chefe de comunicação do PT ao encontro de Flávio Bolsonaro e Vorcaro
item.description: The PT's National Secretary of Communication, Éden Valadares, criticized the meeting between Flávio Bolsonaro and banker Daniel Vorcaro, claiming the PL senator has concealed information and lied repeatedly. Valadares stated the PT will not rest until the truth about Flávio Bolsonaro is revealed to the country, emphasizing that truth is the greatest enemy of the ex-president's son.

item.title: Reunião de Flávio com PL tem cobrança de parlamentares, revelação sobre encontro com Vorcaro e trailer de ‘Dark Horse’
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro met with PL allies to contain the fallout from the 'Dark Horse' film financing scandal involving Daniel Vorcaro, insisting there is nothing more to reveal beyond what has already surfaced. He admitted to meeting Vorcaro again after the banker’s first arrest, causing discomfort among allies fearing further leaks. The meeting included a trailer screening and was attended by party leaders such as Valdemar Costa Neto, Rogério Marinho, and Sérgio Moro.

item.title: “Só te agradecer, meu irmão”, diz Mario Frias a Vorcaro em áudio
item.description: Federal Deputy Mario Frias (PL-SP) thanked banker Daniel Vorcaro, former owner of Master, for his financial support of the film Dark Horse, which portrays the trajectory of former President Jair Bolsonaro. The message, sent via audio, was disclosed by Intercept Brasil and highlights ties between Bolsonaro allies and conservative financial sectors.

item.title: Brasil tem a camisa de seleção mais cara entre os países campeões da Copa do Mundo, com alta acima da inflação
item.description: Brazil's 2026 World Cup jersey is the most expensive among past World Cup-winning nations, priced at R$ 749,99. According to BBC News Brasil, this equals 17.5% of Brazil's average monthly per capita income (US$ 859, or R$ 4.289) based on World Bank data, rising to 22.2% using IBGS figures (R$ 3.367). The price exceeds inflation and raises concerns about accessibility for fans.

item.title: Áudios de Flávio a Vorcaro abalam tentativa de superar desgaste da rachadinha, diz analista do AtlasIntel
item.description: The release of audio recordings between Senator Flávio Bolsonaro (PL-RJ) and Daniel Vorcaro delivers a significant setback to his presidential pre-candidacy, as it strengthens the perception of his involvement in the Banco Master scandal and undermines his efforts to distance himself from corruption cases like the 'rachadinha'. According to AtlasIntel, his voting intentions dropped from 47.8% to 41.8% in a hypothetical second-round matchup against Lula, while the incumbent rose to 48.9%. Analyst Yuri Sanches notes that Flávio’s recovery hinges on potential image crises for the Lula government, as the reputational damage from the Master case may persist until the election.

item.title: AGU pede ao STF que Lei da Dosimetria seja suspensa e declarada inconstitucional
item.description: The AGU has asked the STF to suspend and declare unconstitutional the Dosimetry Law, which reduces sentences for those involved in the January 8, 2023, coup attempts. The law benefits convicts of anti-democracy crimes, including Jair Bolsonaro, allowing regime progression after serving just 1/6 of the sentence, compared to 25% or 30% for common crimes. The AGU argues it violates equality under Article 5 of the Constitution and undermines the democratic rule of law.

item.title: Lula sinaliza apoio a setores para redução da jornada 6x1
item.description: President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva signaled support for reducing the 6x1 workweek, stating the change will be implemented collaboratively, respecting the specificities of each economic sector. He emphasized the goal of giving workers more time for rest, leisure, and study, without imposition, and highlighted the construction sector's importance for job creation and national development.

item.title: Em meio a suspeitas sobre Master, Flávio publica trailer do filme sobre Bolsonaro
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro posted and later removed the trailer for 'Dark Horse', a film about Jair Bolsonaro's political trajectory, amid a crisis involving allegations of illegal financing from Daniel Vorcaro, owner of Banco Master. The film allegedly received up to R$ 61 million linked to the banker, who is under investigation, prompting petitions to the TSE to block its release before the elections. The controversy has raised concerns among allies about the potential damage to Flávio Bolsonaro's presidential pre-candidacy.

item.title: Trailer de ‘Dark Horse’ exibido em reunião tem facada como conluio do sistema contra Bolsonaro; veja
item.description: Senator Flávio Bolsonaro screened a trailer for the film 'Dark Horse' at a party meeting, depicting the 2018 stabbing of Jair Bolsonaro as part of a systemic conspiracy to prevent his election. The trailer, already leaked online, suggests the attack was guided by others, despite Federal Police findings that Adelio Bispo acted alone. The content also reveals negotiations to finance the film through Banco Master, with up to US$10 million already paid, according to documents from the Master case investigation.

item.title: Flávio Bolsonaro confirma que encontrou Vorcaro após prisão
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro confirmed he met with former banker Daniel Vorcaro after Vorcaro's first arrest in November 2025, when Vorcaro was under electronic ankle monitor following 11 days in detention. The meeting took place after Vorcaro's provisional release, linked to Banco Master.

item.title: Flávio Bolsonaro propõe jornada flexível contra fim da escala 6×1
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro (PL-RJ) proposed a flexible work schedule as an alternative to the federal government's project to end the 6×1 work scale. The senator and pre-candidate for president argued that the current CLT model is outdated and does not keep up with new forms of work. The proposal was made during a meeting with PL deputies, reinforcing his stance in favor of greater flexibility in labor relations.

item.title: Revelação de que Flávio visitou Vorcaro amplia clima de desconfiança na bancada do PL
item.description: Senator Flávio Bolsonaro (PL-RJ) admitted to visiting Daniel Vorcaro, owner of Banco Master, after the banker’s arrest in November, increasing distrust within the PL caucus. The delayed disclosure, combined with Vorcaro’s financing of a film about Jair Bolsonaro and the lack of transparency on financial flows, has led allies to question the senator’s credibility and fear electoral consequences.

item.title: Aliados de Lula pedem ao TSE que proíba exibição do filme sobre Bolsonaro no período eleitoral
item.description: Allies of President Lula have requested the TSE to prohibit the exhibition of the film 'Dark Horse', a production about Jair Bolsonaro's political trajectory, arguing it constitutes concealed and premature electoral propaganda. The film, slated for a September release just one month before the 2026 elections, is alleged to be financed by millions of dollars from controversial sources, including payments from banker Daniel Vorcaro, who is imprisoned for fraud at Banco Master, and suspected fund transfers to a U.S.-based entity linked to Eduardo Bolsonaro.

item.title: Alegações de Flávio Bolsonaro para derrubar pesquisa são falsas, diz analista do AtlasIntel
item.description: AtlasIntel analyst Yuri Sanches states that Flávio Bolsonaro's claims of research manipulation are false, as the audio of his conversation with Daniel Vorcaro was presented only after the main questionnaire was completed. The seven-point drop in Flávio's voting intentions against Lula reflects the real impact of the revealed conversations, not methodological bias.

item.title: AGU pede ao STF que mantenha suspensa a Lei da Dosimetria
item.description: The Attorney General's Office (AGU) urged the Supreme Federal Court (STF) to maintain the suspension of the Dosimetry Law (Law No. 15.402/2026), which reduces sentences and eases regime progression for those convicted of the January 8 attacks, including former President Jair Bolsonaro. The AGU argues the law creates a lenient regime for anti-democratic crimes, violates constitutional protections, and contains legislative irregularities, such as the improper splitting of the presidential veto and failure to return the bill to the Chamber after Senate amendments.

item.title: Flávio admite encontro com Vorcaro após prisão de dono do Master
item.description: Senator Flávio Bolsonaro (PL-RJ) confirmed he met with Daniel Vorcaro, owner of Banco Master, after Vorcaro's arrest by the Federal Police in late 2025. The meeting in São Paulo aimed to 'put an end' to their relationship, as Vorcaro was an investor in the film Dark Horse, about Jair Bolsonaro. Flávio stated he was unaware of the tax fraud before the bank's liquidation and that the contact was solely related to the movie project.

item.title: Flávio tenta virar página do caso Master com promessa de transparência
item.description: Senator Flávio Bolsonaro (PL-RJ) sought to turn the political fallout from the Banco Master scandal into an opportunity, promising transparency after a meeting with the PL caucus. He stated he had ordered a full accounting related to the film 'Dark Horse,' tied to the scandal, as a way to regain initiative amid the crisis.

item.title: AGU defende no STF inconstitucionalidade da Lei da Dosimetria
item.description: The Attorney General's Office (AGU) argued before the Supreme Federal Court (STF) that the Dosimetry Law is unconstitutional, claiming it was enacted by the Senate after presidential vetoes, violating executive competence and constitutional procedure. The AGU also requested an injunction to immediately suspend the law, stating it creates a lenient sentencing regime for state crimes, even when violent, contradicting penal law principles that impose harsher penalties for group attacks on institutions. Congress defended the law, asserting the Senate's changes were merely technical improvements and part of a mature democratic debate.

item.title: Nunes Marques vai decidir sobre pedido do PL para impugnar pesquisa da AtlasIntel
item.description: TSE President Nunes Marques will review the PL's request to nullify an AtlasIntel poll showing declining support for Flávio Bolsonaro after audio surfaced of him seeking funds from banker Daniel Vorcaro for a film about Jair Bolsonaro. The PL claims the poll is biased due to embedding the audio in the questionnaire, while AtlasIntel denies wrongdoing, stating the audio is played after the questionnaire to measure real-time voter perception impact. Although initially assigned to Minister Estela Aranha via random draw, the case was reassigned to the TSE presidency, where Nunes Marques may rule on the urgency request or refer it to another justice.

item.title: Flávio admite encontro com Vorcaro após prisão e cobra CPMI
item.description: Senator Flávio Bolsonaro admitted to having met with banker Daniel Vorcaro after the businessman's first arrest, while Vorcaro was already wearing an electronic ankle monitor and could not leave São Paulo. Flávio also demanded the installation of a CPMI to investigate the case, though he did not specify the reason for the meeting.

item.title: Lula diz a empresários que escala 6x1 vai respeitar realidades de setores: 'Ninguém vai impor na marra'
item.description: President Lula told business leaders in São Paulo that any reduction in working hours (6x1 scale) will be implemented respecting the realities of each sector and profession, without authoritarian imposition. He emphasized that the change responds to societal demand for more leisure and family time, and that the government will seek to balance workers' rights with the productive realities of businesses.

item.title: O ponto sensível para aliados de Flávio Bolsonaro no caso do áudio para Vorcaro
item.description: The scandal involving Senator Flávio Bolsonaro and banker Daniel Vorcaro intensified after audio revelations exposed their close relationship, contradicting the senator's public denials. Columnist Robson Bonin stated this has caused significant backlash among Flávio's allies, who feel deceived by the sustained false narrative despite emerging evidence. Vorcaro's transfer to a common cell and the assessment that his plea deal is insufficient have increased pressure on the banker and deepened the political crisis.

item.title: Flávio Bolsonaro visitou Vorcaro um dia após a prisão do banqueiro
item.description: Senator Flávio Bolsonaro (PL-RJ), a pre-candidate for the Presidency of the Republic, visited the residence of banker Daniel Vorcaro in São Paulo one day after Vorcaro’s arrest by the Federal Police in Operation Compliance Zero. The information was reported by Metrópoles and comes amid a morning meeting of the PL parliamentary bloc.

item.title: Presidente do PT descarta candidatura de Pacheco ao governo de Minas e diz que partido busca alternativa para eleição estadual
item.description: The national president of the Workers' Party (PT), Edinho Silva, ruled out Senator Rodrigo Pacheco (PSB) as a candidate for governor of Minas Gerais, stating Pacheco opted not to run. The party is now seeking strong alternatives, including Alexandre Kalil (PDT), Josué Alencar, and Marília Campos, though it faces historical tensions and challenges in aligning with the federal government.

item.title: A legalidade da reapresentação de Jorge Messias
item.description: The Senate's rejection of Jorge Messias' nomination to the STF on April 29 was followed by an administrative act (Ato 01/2010) attempting to block the re-nomination of the same name in the same legislative session. This act, lacking constitutional authority, has been criticized as a flagrant unconstitutional overreach that alters the balance of powers without amendment, debate, or vote. The President has signaled intent to resend the nomination, reigniting debate over senatorial limits and executive autonomy in STF appointments.

item.title: Pesquisa: Flávio despenca entre eleitores do Sudeste, reduto bolsonarista, e Lula ganha fôlego
item.description: The Atlas/Bloomberg poll shows Senator Flávio Bolsonaro (PL-RJ) dropping 10 percentage points in the Southeast, falling from 41.2% to 30.7% in one month after audio emerged of him requesting funds from banker Daniel Vorcaro to finance a film about his father. Lula rose from 43.1% to 48.6% in the same region, opening an 18-point lead over the Bolsonaro-aligned candidate. The Southeast, the traditional stronghold of the Bolsonaro family, includes the three largest electoral colleges: São Paulo, Minas Gerais, and Rio de Janeiro.

item.title: Flávio Bolsonaro visitou Vorcaro após primeira prisão do ex-banqueiro por caso Master
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro, senator and pre-candidate for president from the PL party, visited Daniel Vorcaro, owner of Banco Master, after the former banker’s first arrest in late 2025. The visit was confirmed by Bolsonaro in an interview with Metrópoles on Tuesday, May 19, 2026, sparking speculation about political alliances and support for figures linked to the financial sector under investigation.

item.title: Vorcaro bancou mais de 90% do orçamento de filme sobre Jair Bolsonaro
item.description: Banker Daniel Vorcaro financed over 90% of the budget for the film 'Dark Horse', about Jair Bolsonaro, through the U.S.-based Heavengate fund, despite claiming to act only as an intermediary. After his arrest, the production company GoUp had to seek new investors but continued filming. Senator Flávio Bolsonaro confirmed Vorcaro contributed just over US$12 million, or about 92% of the film’s total US$13 million budget.

item.title: A explicação do diretor da AtlasIntel sobre polêmica na nova pesquisa Lula x Flávio
item.description: The AtlasIntel poll released on March 19 showed Lula with 47% of voting intentions in the first round and Flávio Bolsonaro with 34%, with Lula also leading in a potential runoff (48.9% to 41.8%). Yuri Sanches, political risk director at AtlasIntel, attributed Flávio’s decline to the leaked audio involving him and banker Daniel Vorcaro, but denied methodological contamination, stating the audio was presented only after the electoral questionnaire was completed.

item.title: Flávio Bolsonaro diz que esteve na casa de Vorcaro após primeira prisão do dono do Master
item.description: Senator Flávio Bolsonaro confirmed visiting banker Daniel Vorcaro in December 2025, following Vorcaro’s first arrest in the Banco Master case, stating he sought private funding for a film about his father, Jair Bolsonaro. He denied using public funds or the Rouanet Law and called for a CPI into Banco Master. Although reports allege negotiations for up to US$ 24 million, with US$ 10 million already paid per investigation documents, the Federal Police has not yet opened a specific investigation into him.

item.title: Crusoé: “Disparei na Atlas”, comemora Renan Santos
item.description: Renan Santos, pre-candidate for president from the Missão party, celebrated his third-place finish in the Atlas Intel poll, where he received 6.9% of voter intentions in the first round of the 2026 elections, behind only Lula (47%) and Flávio Bolsonaro (34.3%). Romeu Zema came in fourth with 5.2%. Santos highlighted the result as an achievement, saying 'I hit the mark on Atlas'.

item.title: A decepção do PL ‘raiz’ com Flávio Bolsonaro
item.description: The 'root' wing of the PL expresses disappointment with Senator Flávio Bolsonaro over his negotiations with banker Daniel Vorcaro, seen as an unnecessary liability for the campaign. The group believes Flávio exposed himself to avoidable damage by aligning with someone viewed as 'Brazil’s most radioactive man,' sparking internal frustration and fear of further revelations. His candidacy now hinges on upcoming polls and Jair Bolsonaro’s final say, with discussions underway about replacing him on the ticket.

item.title: Aliados de Lula acionam o TSE contra exibição de ‘Dark Horse’ durante eleições
item.description: Allies of President Lula have filed a petition with the TSE to ban the screening of the film ‘Dark Horse’, a biopic of Jair Bolsonaro, during the 2026 electoral period, citing risks of economic power abuse and illicit political financing. The petition alleges negotiations between Flávio Bolsonaro and Daniel Vorcaro of Banco Master to fund the film, raising suspicions of undisclosed corporate donations, money laundering, and international fund triangulation, and requests hearings and data sharing with electoral and financial authorities.

item.title: Flávio admite reunião com Vorcaro, quando banqueiro estava com tornozeleira eletrônica, 'para botar ponto final na questão' de filme
item.description: Senator Flávio Bolsonaro (PL-RJ), a pre-candidate for president in 2026, admitted he met with banker Daniel Vorcaro, owner of Banco Master, after Vorcaro’s first arrest in November 2025, when the banker was already wearing an electronic ankle monitor. The meeting aimed to 'put an end to the matter' regarding the financing of the film 'Dark Horse', a biopic of Jair Bolsonaro, which had received approximately R$61 million from Vorcaro before his arrest. Flávio stated that, had he been informed earlier of the severity of the situation, he would have sought other investors to avoid the risk of the project being halted.

item.title: Vereadora de SP vai coordenar campanha de Renan Santos à Presidência
item.description: São Paulo city councilwoman Amanda Vettorazzo (União Brasil) will coordinate the presidential campaign of Renan Santos (Missão). Santos, founder of the Brazil Free Movement (MBL), is relying on his strong social media presence to attract right-wing voters in the 2026 election.

item.title: Flávio treina respostas a jornalistas e se justifica para base partidária
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro's (PL) campaign has entered 'damage control' mode following recent controversies, with the presidential pre-candidate training responses to journalists and justifying himself to the party base. The goal is to mitigate negative impacts and strengthen internal support amid media and opposition pressure.

item.title: Caso Banco Master: PF faz operação contra perito que teria vazado dados à imprensa
item.description: The Federal Police conducted an operation in Rondônia to investigate a leak of confidential information by a federal forensic expert linked to Operation Compliance Zero, which probes alleged billion-dollar frauds at Banco Master. The expert allegedly passed secret data to a journalist in December 2024 and January 2025, unrelated to the Intercept audio leaks involving Senator Flávio Bolsonaro and banker Daniel Vorcaro. The STF issued precautionary measures, including suspension of the officer’s duties, emphasizing the probe targets public officials, not journalists or press freedom.
